package handlers

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/queryfields"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/transport/http/admin/v1/parsers"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/techversion"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
	"github.com/go-playground/validator/v10"
)

// TechVersionHandler exposes tech version endpoints.
type TechVersionHandler struct {
	Validator *validator.Validate
	CreateUC  techversion.CreateTechVersion
	UpdateUC  techversion.UpdateTechVersion
	DeleteUC  techversion.DeleteTechVersion
	ListUC    techversion.ListTechVersions
}

type createTechVersionRequest struct {
	TechID  int    `json:"tech_id" validate:"required,min=1"`
	Version string `json:"version" validate:"required,max=32"`
}

// Create handles POST /tech-version/create.
func (h TechVersionHandler) Create(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	var req createTechVersionRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	if err := h.Validator.Struct(req); err != nil {
		writeValidationError(w, err)
		return
	}
	version, err := h.CreateUC.Handle(r.Context(), techversion.CreateTechVersionInput{
		TechID:  req.TechID,
		Version: req.Version,
	})
	if err != nil {
		if err == domain.ErrNotFound {
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusNotFound)
			return
		}
		if err == domain.ErrConflict {
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusConflict)
			return
		}
		if err == domain.ErrValidation {
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusUnprocessableEntity)
			return
		}
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusCreated)
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{
		"tech_version": map[string]any{
			"id":         version.ID,
			"tech_id":    version.TechID,
			"version":    version.Version,
			"created_at": version.CreatedAt,
		},
	})
}

type updateTechVersionRequest struct {
	Version string `json:"version" validate:"required,max=32"`
}

// Update handles PUT /tech-version/update/{techVersionID}.
func (h TechVersionHandler) Update(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	versionID := chi.URLParam(r, "techVersionID")
	parsedVersionID, err := parsePositiveIntPathParam(versionID, "techVersionID")
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	var req updateTechVersionRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	if err := h.Validator.Struct(req); err != nil {
		writeValidationError(w, err)
		return
	}
	version, err := h.UpdateUC.Handle(r.Context(), techversion.UpdateTechVersionInput{
		ID:      parsedVersionID,
		Version: req.Version,
	})
	if err != nil {
		if err == domain.ErrNotFound {
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusNotFound)
			return
		}
		if err == domain.ErrConflict {
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusConflict)
			return
		}
		if err == domain.ErrValidation {
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusUnprocessableEntity)
			return
		}
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{
		"tech_version": map[string]any{
			"id":         version.ID,
			"tech_id":    version.TechID,
			"version":    version.Version,
			"created_at": version.CreatedAt,
		},
	})
}

// Delete handles DELETE /tech-version/delete/{techVersionID}.
func (h TechVersionHandler) Delete(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	versionID := chi.URLParam(r, "techVersionID")
	parsedVersionID, err := parsePositiveIntPathParam(versionID, "techVersionID")
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	if err := h.DeleteUC.Handle(r.Context(), parsedVersionID); err != nil {
		if err == domain.ErrNotFound {
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusNotFound)
			return
		}
		if err == domain.ErrConflict {
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusConflict)
			return
		}
		if err == domain.ErrValidation {
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusUnprocessableEntity)
			return
		}
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
}

// List handles GET /tech-version/list.
func (h TechVersionHandler) List(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	fieldsParam := r.URL.Query().Get("fields")
	f := queryfields.Parse(fieldsParam, queryfields.TechVersionAllowedFields)
	filters, err := parsers.ParseTechVersionFilters(r, h.Validator)
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	items, total, err := h.ListUC.Handle(r.Context(), filters)
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	if items == nil {
		items = []domain.TechVersion{}
	}
	result := make([]map[string]any, 0, len(items))
	for _, tv := range items {
		item := map[string]any{}
		if f.Has("id") {
			item["id"] = tv.ID
		}
		if f.Has("tech_id") {
			item["tech_id"] = tv.TechID
		}
		if f.Has("version") {
			item["version"] = tv.Version
		}
		if f.Has("created_at") {
			item["created_at"] = tv.CreatedAt
		}
		result = append(result, item)
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{
		"tech_versions": result,
		"meta":          buildPaginationMeta(filters.Page, filters.Limit, total),
	})
}
